      "alternative": "The trajectory may still make progress after isolated blocked requests, or the changed block may redirect route choices without producing a terminal stall or repeated recent blocks.",
      "falsification": "A single blocked result, blocked results outside the detector's recent window, no nearby obstacle, or continued terminal progress would not support obstacle interference.",
      "intent": "mechanism_transfer",
      "target_family": "obstacle_interference",

      ],
      "vulnerability": "The reviewed sequence included blocked requests but later movement and staging arrivals; the blocks were not repeated at the same endpoint and did not produce a terminal stall.       "failure_prediction": "A future FAIL may meet the obstacle-interference detector only if the complete terminal trace is stalled, there are at least two accepted blocked_endpoint/no_path results in the recent window, and a nearby obstacle meets the detector's distance criterion.",
      "change_rationale": "Branch from the selected FAIL anchor, changing human_trigger_distance_m from 0.7413 to 2.5 and obstacle_2_lateral_fraction from 0.8437 to 0.55. These changes are in the human and layout groups and each exceeds the minimum normalized change. The obstacle's lateral fraction changes its position under the specified mapping, so the second route segment may present a different approach constraint; the proxy's trigger changes crossing timing, not robot settings. This is a probe of whether the observed pattern of early blocks followed by progress changes into recent repeated blocks with a terminal stall. A competing explanation is that the robot simply chooses a different route or continues progressing, in which case the detector would not qualify.",
      "anchor_case_id": "8af114d9f85f6fb0e04ff538b9c979b68ea1f1b681229b6f6add745393b85a63",
      "anchor_rationale": "This is an unmixed FAIL anchor with the reviewed trajectory and the same two fixed static-block route structure. It supplies the branch parameters and geometry; the recorded blocks alone are not treated as evidence of obstacle interference.",
      "extra_changes": [

          "axis": "obstacle_2_lateral_fraction",
          "value": 0.55
        }
      ],
      "analysis_evidence_id": "624eb320e661057ffba3f665acca883dd2b83c912d81b290a8195d6c97b1fb6a",
      "measurement_plan": {
        "required_observation": "Record a complete terminal stalled window, at least two accepted plan_path/navigate_to no_path or blocked_endpoint results within the recent 10-second detector window, and a nearby obstacle satisfying the fixed detector distance criterion.",
        "exclusions_addressed": "A lone blocked result, earlier blocked requests outside the recent window, no_tracking_clearance alone, or inferred global unreachability do not qualify.",
        "expected_contact_scope": "unknown"
